remarks: A generous great room, a downstairs bedroom and an upstairs loft with mountain views make this Caspian Villas townhome especially versatile. Approximately 1,930 square feet provide three bedrooms and a layout that gives everyone room to spread out. A wide sliding glass door brings light into the connected kitchen, dining and living areas, creating an inviting setting for meals and gatherings. The main-level bedroom includes a walk-in closet and a nearby three-quarter bathroom, with a separate powder room serving the living space.
